facts.summary: Discontinued prior ceDNA constructs for new iqDNA; lead program reset · Preclinical · iqDNA factor VIII in hemophilia A · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Due to the superior tolerability profile of iqDNA, Generation Bio is discontinuing development of prior ceDNA constructs and is advancing iqDNA as the cargo for its lead program in hemophilia A
evidence.program_discontinued: Generation Bio is discontinuing development of prior ceDNA constructs and is advancing iqDNA as the cargo for its lead program in hemophilia A as well as for all other programs.
